{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the cross-tabulation of `sex` vs `severity` and `arm` to see if sex is confounded
print("Cross-tabulation of `sex` vs `severity`:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity']))

print("\nCross-tabulation of `sex` vs `arm`:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm']))"}
